events.factual_description: NOHGA HOTEL UENO TOKYO presents UENO JAZZ NIGHT 2026 at Bistro NOHGA on Friday, September 11, 2026. The September 11 lineup is Rena Toshimitsu on vocals and drums, Naoto Suzuki on guitar, and Joe Endo (Sadamu Endo) on bass. Three twenty-minute stages begin at 7:00 PM, 8:00 PM, and 9:00 PM. The hotel states that there is no music charge. Its artist profile notes that Toshimitsu has performed with pianist Tsuyoshi Yamamoto and highlights her recent practice of singing while playing snare drum, combining her perspectives as drummer and vocalist.

en.why_it_matters: Rena Toshimitsu sits unusually close to the Yamamoto thread without simply replaying it: NOHGA presents her singing while playing drums, the dual role she has been developing, alongside guitarist Naoto Suzuki—the guitarist from Listening Notes' first lived ALFIE night—and bassist Joe Endo. Three compact Ueno sets make this a small-scale continuation of the Tokyo listening path, with instrumental identity and archive continuity doing the work rather than venue prestige.
en.trip_verdict: If Ueno already fits the evening, drop in for one of the three short sets or time dinner around two of them. I would keep a scarcer club date or major-master appearance ahead of it; the appeal here is a low-friction, unusually specific branch of the Yamamoto/ALFIE thread.

es.why_it_matters: Rena Toshimitsu queda muy cerca del hilo Yamamoto sin limitarse a repetirlo: NOHGA la presenta cantando y tocando batería, ese doble papel que viene desarrollando, junto a Naoto Suzuki —el guitarrista de la primera noche vivida de Listening Notes en ALFIE— y el bajista Joe Endo. Tres sets breves en Ueno convierten la fecha en una continuación pequeña pero concreta del recorrido tokiota, donde pesan la identidad instrumental y la continuidad del archivo, no el prestigio de la sala.
es.trip_verdict: Si Ueno ya encaja en la noche, entraría a uno de los tres sets breves o acomodaría la cena para escuchar dos. Mantendría por delante una fecha de club más escasa o la aparición de un gran maestro; el valor aquí está en ser una ramificación muy específica y de baja fricción del hilo Yamamoto/ALFIE.
